title: HighLevel (GoHighLevel) Pricing in 2026: Starter, Unlimited and Founder
summary: HighLevel (GoHighLevel) lists Starter at $97, Unlimited at $297 and Founder at $497 a month with unlimited users. Calls are billed by usage at $0.0166 a minute.
body_markdown:
HighLevel, which many people call GoHighLevel, publishes three plan prices. Starter is $97 a month, Unlimited is $297 a month and Founder is $497 a month. Each is a flat price for the account with unlimited users, not a price per seat. Enterprise is quoted. Calling is on every plan and is billed by usage: $0.0166 a minute for outbound calls in the US and Canada, and $1.15 a month for a local number. There is a 14-day free trial. The pages were read on November 18, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a dialer that competes with HighLevel's own calling tools and also works inside HighLevel. Every HighLevel detail below comes from HighLevel's own pricing page, help centre and terms of service, opened on November 18, 2026. No price here comes from a review site. No HighLevel account or trial was used and nothing was tested. Prices are in US dollars. For the calling routes inside the product, see[how to make calls from GoHighLevel](https://www.trellus.ai/post/how-to-make-calls-from-gohighlevel) .


## HighLevel pricing at a glance


HighLevel and GoHighLevel are the same product. The[pricing page](https://www.gohighlevel.com/pricing) sits on gohighlevel.com, is titled "HighLevel Pricing", and its footer names HighLevel LLC, a subsidiary of GoHighLevel Inc. This guide uses the vendor's spelling, HighLevel.


On November 18, 2026, the page showed monthly prices only. It displayed no annual price and no switch between billing terms. No Black Friday or other sale price was showing.


HighLevel plans in US dollars per account a month, as displayed on HighLevel's own pricing page, read on November 18, 2026. Phone, SMS, email and AI usage is billed separately on every plan. Plan Price a month Annual price Users and seat minimum Free trial What is included for calling


Starter $97 Not shown Unlimited users; no seat minimum; 3 sub-accounts 14 days Inbound and outbound calling, 2 way SMS and the Workflow Builder. Calls, texts and numbers are billed by usage


Unlimited $297 Not shown Unlimited users; no seat minimum; unlimited sub-accounts 14 days Starter plus a white-label desktop app, basic API access and pass-through billing of usage to clients


Founder $497 Not shown Unlimited users; no seat minimum; unlimited sub-accounts 14 days Unlimited plus SaaS mode with unlimited reselling. Phone usage can be rebilled to clients with a markup


Enterprise Not published; custom Not published Not stated Speak with the enterprise team The full feature set of the highest plan, with premium support and HIPAA compliance included


The plan names vary on HighLevel's own pages. The $497 card is named Founder. The FAQ on the same page calls it the Pro Plan. HighLevel's[pricing guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001156-highlevel-pricing-guide) in the help centre names the three tiers Starter, Unlimited and Founder.


The page says the 14-day trial gives full access to the features of the chosen tier. Its disclaimer says billing begins automatically at the end of the trial unless the account is cancelled, and that usage-based fees for telecommunications may apply during the trial.


## What changes the real cost of HighLevel


The plan price is public and does not rise with the number of users. The bill also depends on phone usage, numbers, texting registration, add-ons and how many client accounts you run.


### Calls are billed by the minute


The pricing page lists inbound and outbound calling as a core feature and marks it "Usage based charges apply".


The help centre's pricing guide says the Phone System is available on all plan levels and that its pricing matches Twilio's. HighLevel's[LC Phone pricing and billing guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001223556-phone-system-pricing-billing-guide) , last modified on October 12, 2026, gives these US and Canada rates:


- **Outbound calls:** $0.0166 a minute in total, made up of $0.0126 for the call and $0.004 in client minutes.
- **Inbound calls:** $0.01165 a minute when answered on the web, mobile app or a desk phone, and $0.02 a minute when forwarded to a US number.
- **Local numbers:** $1.15 a month. Toll-free numbers are $2.15 a month.
- **Call recording:** $0.0025 a minute. Call transcription is $0.024 a minute.


The guide says calls are billed in full minutes and any partial minute rounds up.


### Texting and registration


The same guide lists SMS at $0.00747 a segment in the US and Canada, sent or received, plus carrier fees of $0.0025 to $0.01 a segment. US texting needs A2P registration. The guide lists a one-time registration fee of $22.50 or $64 by campaign type, and a monthly campaign fee of up to $10.50.


### The wallet


Usage is paid from a prepaid Agency Wallet. The pricing guide says HighLevel deducts each charge from the wallet and automatically charges the card on file to refill it when the balance falls below the minimum.


### The Power Dialer and the multi-line dialer


HighLevel's[Web Dialer article](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000981431-outbound-calls-with-dialer-in-web-app-softphone-) lists three calling options. The Web Dialer is for individual calls. "Manual Actions / Power Dialer" is a queue: a workflow creates manual call tasks under Conversations, then Manual Actions, and a rep works through them. The third is the mobile app. The pages read list no separate fee for the Power Dialer, and the Workflow Builder is on the Starter card.


HighLevel's[multi-line dialer](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009453-multi-line-dialer) rings up to three contacts at once. The article says it is in private beta. The[multi-line dialer pricing article](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009643-multi-line-dialer-pricing) says there is no flat fee. A round is billed in three parts: the agent connection at $0.004 a minute, each answered contact at $0.0126 a minute, and conference usage at $0.0018 per participant a minute in the US. Dialing one line costs the standard $0.0166 a minute.


### Sub-accounts and rebilling


The pricing page's FAQ says Starter includes three sub-accounts and the two higher plans include unlimited sub-accounts. An account that needs more than three sub-accounts needs Unlimited at $297.


The pricing guide says phone usage can be rebilled to clients without a markup on the $297 and $497 plans, and with a markup only on the $497 plan.


### Add-ons


The pricing page lists optional add-ons with monthly prices:


- **AI Employee:** $50 a month per sub-account on the Growth plan, or $97 on the Unlimited plan. The pricing guide says phone charges still apply to calls handled by Voice AI.
- **Premium support:** $500 a month.
- **HIPAA compliance:** $297 a month.


Email is also usage-based. The pricing guide lists $0.675 per 1,000 emails on all plans.


### Contract, renewal and refunds


The pricing page's FAQ says HighLevel is month to month with no long-term contract, and that an account can be upgraded, downgraded or cancelled at any time from the dashboard.


HighLevel's[terms of service](https://www.gohighlevel.com/terms-of-service) say subscriptions are billed in advance on a monthly or annual basis, renew automatically at the then-current rates, and that all fees are non-refundable.


## Who HighLevel fits and who it does not


HighLevel describes itself as an all-in-one platform that replaces a CRM, funnel builder, email marketing tool, appointment scheduler and SMS tool. The page says Starter is for one business or a few clients and Unlimited is for agencies managing unlimited clients.


That fits a marketing agency or a small business that wants one account with unlimited users.


HighLevel is a weaker fit for a buyer who wants a fixed price for calling, because minutes, numbers and texts are billed by usage on every plan. It is a weaker fit for a team that only wants a dialer, since every plan is a full marketing and CRM platform. A team that wants to call several numbers at once should note that HighLevel's own multi-line dialer is in private beta and stops at three lines.

HighLevel prices by account. These vendors print a price per seat. Calling usage, numbers and taxes can be extra.

**Trellus** is a Chrome extension that adds power and parallel dialing inside the CRM, sales engagement platform or spreadsheet a team already uses. It works with 31 platforms. The[Trellus power dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/power-dialer) plan, Power, is $99.99 per seat per month. The[Trellus parallel dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/parallel-dialer) plan, Power + Parallel, is $149.99 and calls up to five numbers at once. Both are bought online with no seat minimum. There is no free plan or free trial, and the Business plan is custom. The plan details are on[Trellus pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/pricing) .


Trellus is not a CRM and does not replace HighLevel. A team keeps its HighLevel plan and adds Trellus seats for the reps who call. Trellus power or parallel dials a Contacts Smart List without a CSV export, then saves a contact note, a selected tag and a callback task in HighLevel: see[Trellus for GoHighLevel](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/gohighlevel) .


HighLevel calling is billed by the minute on top of a flat account price. Trellus is priced per seat and includes calling: about 1,300 US minutes per seat each week on Power and about 2,000 on Power + Parallel.


For other dialers that run inside HighLevel, see the guide to a[GoHighLevel dialer alternative](https://www.trellus.ai/post/go-high-level-dialer-alternative) and the comparison of[Trellus and WAVV](https://www.trellus.ai/compare/trellus-vs-wavv) . For CRMs with built-in calling, see[Close pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/post/close-crm-pricing) and[HubSpot Sales Hub pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/post/hubspot-sales-hub-pricing) .


## Frequently asked questions


### How much does GoHighLevel cost per month?


On November 18, 2026, HighLevel's pricing page listed Starter at $97 a month, Unlimited at $297 and Founder at $497. Enterprise is quoted. Phone, SMS, email and AI usage is billed on top of the plan price.


### Is HighLevel the same as GoHighLevel?


Yes. The product's website is gohighlevel.com and its pricing page is titled "HighLevel Pricing". Its footer names HighLevel LLC, a subsidiary of GoHighLevel Inc.


### Does HighLevel charge per user?


No. The pricing page says every plan has unlimited users and unlimited contacts. Starter includes three sub-accounts, and Unlimited and Founder include unlimited sub-accounts.


### Does HighLevel have a free trial?


Yes. The pricing page offers a 14-day free trial on any plan. It says billing begins automatically at the end of the trial unless the account is cancelled, and that telecommunications usage fees may apply during the trial.


### Are calls included in the HighLevel plan price?


No. Calling is a core feature on every plan, but it is billed by usage. HighLevel's phone pricing guide lists US and Canada outbound calls at $0.0166 a minute and a local number at $1.15 a month. Calls are rounded up to full minutes.


### Does HighLevel have a power dialer?


Yes. HighLevel's help centre uses the name Power Dialer for Manual Actions, a queue of call tasks that a workflow creates. A separate multi-line dialer that rings up to three contacts at once was in private beta on November 18, 2026.
